errors.evidence: The green slice, corresponding to the category '81 - 100 услуги', does not have a percentage label. The description incorrectly assigns it the value 13%, which belongs to the orange slice ('51 - 80 услуги').
The turquoise slice, corresponding to the category 'Не се предоставят', does not have a percentage label. The value 13.9% is hallucinated and does not appear anywhere in the figure.

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени върху кръга в низходящ ред по големина
errors.evidence: The statement that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size is incorrect. The order of the slices does not follow a size-based arrangement. For instance, the second largest slice (purple, 28.3%) is followed by the turquoise slice, which is smaller than the next slice in the sequence (red, 15.2%).

errors.text_span: оранжев и зелен, които са еднакво големи
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the orange and green sectors are equally large. The orange sector is explicitly labeled as 13%, while the green sector is visibly smaller and has no label.
The description incorrectly identifies the turquoise sector as the smallest. Visually, the green sector ('81 - 100 услуги') is the smallest one.

errors.text_span: Вътре в секторите са изписани техните процентни стойности
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization because not all sectors have their percentage values written inside them. The green and turquoise slices lack percentage labels.
